name: Item Marks (Keep / Trade / Junk)
description: Needs the moddable-engine build (level 5).  Three marks for your items: [K] Keep (the game asks before you drop, throw, disassemble or sell it, crafting avoids it, 'move all' leaves it), [T] Trade goods (not picked by 'select all' in drop menus) and [J] Junk (sorted to the bottom).  In any inventory menu: F2 = Keep, F3 = Trade, F4 = Junk (keys can be changed in the keybinding menu; '#' still opens the full mark menu).  F6 in the game view drops everything marked Junk after asking.  Junk is also set automatically for broken items, empty cans / cups / bottles and wet clothes you are not wearing; every rule can be switched off in Esc -> Mod options, and a mark you remove by hand is never set again on that item.
